title: Imbeya Yashizeho Iragi
intro: Mu bitabu vy’ivya kera vy’ukurwanya, hariho umuntu izina ryiwe nyene ryacitse imburi gushika kw’iherezo ry’ibihe. Uwo muntu yahisemwo urwanko kuruta ubuvukanyi, ugutera umugongo aho kuyoboka, kandi ahagarara arwanya umuhamagaro w’ikigongwe. Umvirize neza ijwi ry’itangazo rya kera uko duhishura akaranga k’uwo mutima uzwi cane.
clues: Navukiye mu muryango umwe n’intumwa ya nyuma ya Allah, yamara narabarwanya aho hose.
Izina ryanje ryari rifise insobanuro, ni ukuvuga izina risobanura ‘se w’urubeya,’ izina ryobaye ryerekana aho nzoja ibihe bidahera.
Narekuye ububi ku wutwara ukuri, mbere n’abo mu rugo rwanje bwite barifatanije muri iyo nzira y’ububisha.
Nakoresheje ubutunzi bwanje n’ububasha bwanje kugira ngo ncereze uguhamagara Allah, nizera ko amahera ashobora kuzimya umuco w’Imana.
Allah yampaye igice cose—igice kigufi cane ku buryo gishobora gusomwa mu masegonda, yamara uburemere bwaco buragumaho gushika ku musi w’urubanza.
Mugenzi wanje wo muri kazoza aragenda inyuma yanje, aboshwe n’umugozi w’urudodo mw’izosi, atwaye amahwa nyene bahora bakwiragiza.
